title: Simple interest grows in a straight line
caption: £5,000 at 6% simple interest earns the same £300 every year, so the total is a straight line. After 9 months (0.75 years) the interest is £225 and £5,225 is repaid.
alt: A straight line from £5,000 at time 0 rising by £300 a year, with the point (0.75, £5,225) marked.
description: Interest is 5000 × 0.06 = £300 for every full year.
After t years the amount is 5000 + 300t, a straight line.
At t = 0.75 years (9 months) the amount is £5,225, of which £225 is interest.
